content: {"praised":["Accessible yet distinctly Jim Jarmusch style.","Subtle beauty realized early in the film.","Philosophical action-drama with strong thematic depth.","Forest Whitaker delivers a compelling lead performance.","Genre blend of samurai and street punk feels respectful."],"criticized":["Boring and slow pacing makes it unengaging.","Plot feels nowhere, confusing and unentertaining.","Acting wasted, especially Forest Whitaker's role.","Poorly executed, fails compared to Branded to Kill.","Overall lack of entertainment value."]}
